before: zip pairs items from separate iterables by their position.

The first name pairs with the first score, then the second with the second.
```python
names = ["Mina", "Luis"]
points = [4, 9]
for name, point in zip(names, points):
    print(name, point)
```
The pairs are Mina with 4 and Luis with 9. zip does not search for matching values or sort the lists.
